tools.name: get_federal_poverty_level
tools.description: Returns the federal poverty line (FPL) used for the ACA premium tax credit for a coverage year, household size and state, plus the 100%, 133%, 138%, 150%, 200%, 250%, 300% and 400% income thresholds. Coverage year Y uses the HHS guidelines published in year Y-1: 2026 coverage uses the 2025 guideline
